quotedTweetMedia.transcription: has. Model allies that step up like Israel, South Korea, Poland, increasingly Germany, the Baltics and others will receive our special favor. Allies that do not, allies that still fail to do their part for collective defense will face consequences. President Trump, makes sense to me, likes helping countries that help themselves. And we feel the same way. That's the nature of partnerships rather than dependencies.
